## Preamble

This script covers the `DESeq2` differential gene expression analysis for our samples.

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
```

## 2. Load Data

Note that this analysis uses the processed gene counts from the subset of observations excluding the 'run1' technical replicate for each 4dpi sample; the reasons for this are discussed in our paper.

### 2.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
rep_metadata <- read_tsv("../data/processed_counts/subset_observations/rep_metadata.tsv")
rep_count_matrix <- read_tsv("../data/processed_counts/subset_observations/rep_count_matrix.tsv")
```

### 2.2 By biological sample

```{r}
sam_metadata <- read_tsv("../data/processed_counts/subset_observations/sam_metadata.tsv")
sam_count_matrix <- read_tsv("../data/processed_counts/subset_observations/sam_count_matrix.tsv")
```

## 3. Convert Data to Format Required for DESeq2

### 3.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
# Convert count matrix into a true matrix
rep_count_matrix <- rep_count_matrix %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id")
rep_count_matrix <- as.matrix(rep_count_matrix)

# Convert metadata data frame to DESeq2 usable form
rep_metadata <- rep_metadata %>% column_to_rownames(var = "rname")
rep_metadata$sname <- as.factor(rep_metadata$sname)
rep_metadata$dpi <- as.factor(rep_metadata$dpi)
rep_metadata$sex <- as.factor(rep_metadata$sex)
rep_metadata$infect <- as.factor(rep_metadata$infect)
```

### 3.2 By biological sample

```{r}
# Convert count matrix into a true matrix
sam_count_matrix <- sam_count_matrix %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene_id")
sam_count_matrix <- as.matrix(sam_count_matrix)

# Generate human readable sample names
sam_metadata <- sam_metadata %>%
  mutate(group = sapply(str_split(sname, "-"), function(x) x[[1]][1])) %>%
  mutate(readable_name = paste(dpi, "dpi", " ",
                               if_else(sex == "F", "female", "male"), " ",
                               if_else(infect == "cov", "infected", "mock"),
                               " (", group, ")", sep = "")) %>%
  select(-group)

# Convert metadata data frame to DESeq2 usable form
sam_metadata <- sam_metadata %>% column_to_rownames(var = "sname")
sam_metadata$dpi <- as.factor(sam_metadata$dpi)
sam_metadata$sex <- as.factor(sam_metadata$sex)
sam_metadata$infect <- as.factor(sam_metadata$infect)
```

## 4. Prepare DESeq2 Matrix & Run Differential Expression Analysis

### 4.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
# Create DESeq2 object
rep_dds_matrix <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rep_count_matrix,
                                         colData = rep_metadata,
                                         design = ~dpi*infect)

# Set control conditions
rep_dds_matrix$dpi <- relevel(rep_dds_matrix$dpi, ref = "4")
rep_dds_matrix$infect <- relevel(rep_dds_matrix$infect, ref = "mock")
rep_dds_matrix$sex <- relevel(rep_dds_matrix$sex, ref = "M")

# Run DESeq2
rep_dds <- DESeq(rep_dds_matrix)
```

### 4.2 By biological sample

```{r}
# Create DESeq2 object
sam_dds_matrix <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = sam_count_matrix, 
                                         colData = sam_metadata,
                                         design = ~dpi*infect)

# Set control conditions
sam_dds_matrix$dpi <- relevel(sam_dds_matrix$dpi, ref = "4")
sam_dds_matrix$infect <- relevel(sam_dds_matrix$infect, ref = "mock")
sam_dds_matrix$sex <- relevel(sam_dds_matrix$sex, ref = "M")

# Run DESeq2
sam_dds <- DESeq(sam_dds_matrix)
```

## 5. Generate & Save PCA Plots

### 5.0 Define Helper Function

```{r}
plot_and_save_PCA <- function(rld, group, output_path) {
  PCA_plot <- plotPCA(rld, intgroup = group) + theme_bw()
  ggsave(output_path, plot = PCA_plot, width = 10, height = 10)
  PCA_plot
}
```

### 5.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
# Perform log transformation on our count data
rep_rld <- vst(rep_dds)

plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, "dpi",
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_dpi.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, "infect",
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_infect.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, "sex",
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_sex.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, c("dpi", "infect"),
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_dpi_infect.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, c("dpi", "sex"),
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_dpi_sex.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, c("infect", "sex"),
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_infect_sex.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, c("dpi", "infect", "sex"),
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_dpi_infect_sex.png")
plot_and_save_PCA(rep_rld, "sname",
                  "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/pca_sample.png")
```


## 6. Generate & Save Euclidean Distance Heatmaps

### 6.0 Define Helper Function

```{r}
plot_and_save_heatmap <- function(rld, names_col, output_path) {
  dists <- dist(t(assay(rld)))
  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dists)
  colnames(dist_matrix) <- NULL
  colours <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)
  heatmap <- pheatmap(dist_matrix,
                      clustering_distance_rows = dists,
                      clustering_distance_cols = dists, 
                      col = colours,
                      labels_row = rld@colData@listData[[names_col]])
  ggsave(output_path, plot = heatmap, width = 12, height = 12)
}
```

### 6.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
plot_and_save_heatmap(rep_rld, "sname",
                      "../visualizations/DESeq2/replicates/euclid_heatmap.png")
```

### 6.2 By biological sample

```{r}
plot_and_save_heatmap(sam_rld, "readable_name",
                      "../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/euclid_heatmap.png")
```

## 7. Further Analysis of Differentially Expressed Genes

### 7.1 By technical replicate

```{r}
# names of the results that DESeq2 calculated
rep_res_names <- resultsNames(rep_dds)
rep_interaction_term <- rep_res_names[4]

# Get results for interaction term
rep_res <- results(rep_dds, name = rep_interaction_term) %>% as.data.frame()

# Getting rid of NA values
rep_res_no_NA <- rep_res %>% drop_na()

# Filtering for adjusted p-values <= 0.05
rep_res_filt <- rep_res_no_NA %>% filter(padj <= 0.05)

# Pull genes with more than 2x higher/lower expression
rep_res_final <- rep_res_filt %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

# top 50 most up-regulated differentially expressed genes
rep_top_upreg <- rep_res_final %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange >= 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  head(n = 50)

# Bottom 50 most down-regulated differentially expressed genes
rep_bot_downreg <- rep_res_final %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  head(n = 50)

# Write Results to file
write_tsv(rep_res_final %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/rep_all_diff_expressed.tsv")
write_tsv(rep_top_upreg %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/rep_top50_upreg.tsv")
write_tsv(rep_bot_downreg %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/rep_bot50_downreg.tsv")
```

### 7.2 By biological sample

```{r}
# names of the results that DESeq2 calculated
sam_res_names <- resultsNames(sam_dds)
sam_interaction_term <- sam_res_names[4]

# Get results for interaction term
sam_res <- results(sam_dds, name = sam_interaction_term) %>% as.data.frame()

# Getting rid of NA values
sam_res_no_NA <- sam_res %>% drop_na()

# Filtering for adjusted p-values <= 0.05
sam_res_filt <- sam_res_no_NA %>% filter(padj <= 0.05)

# Pull genes with more than 2x higher/lower expression
sam_res_final <- sam_res_filt %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

# top 50 most up-regulated differentially expressed genes
sam_top_upreg <- sam_res_final %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange >= 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  head(n = 50)

# Bottom 50 most down-regulated differentially expressed genes
sam_bot_downreg <- sam_res_final %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  head(n = 50)

# Write Results to file
write_tsv(sam_res_final %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/sam_all_diff_expressed.tsv")
write_tsv(sam_top_upreg %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/sam_top50_upreg.tsv")
write_tsv(sam_bot_downreg %>% rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id"),
          file = "../data/DESeq2/sam_bot50_downreg.tsv")
```

## 8. Generate & Save Downstream Figures

At this point in the analysis, we have evaluated that the results by technical replicate and by biological sample are sane and adequately consistent. Hence, we continue with generating downstream figures only for the results by biological samples as that is the primary method by which we intend to analyze/interpret our results.

### 8.0 Prepare Data For Plotting

```{r}
sam_res_plotting <- sam_res_final %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id")

# Top 10 genes with the lowest p-values
top_genes <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id) %>%
  pull()

# Add all fields we may want to use for generating plots
sam_res_plotting <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  mutate(reg_label = case_when(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >= 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
                               padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -1 ~ "Down-regulated",
                               TRUE ~ "Non-significant")) %>%
  mutate(annotation = case_when(gene_id %in% top_genes ~ "GOI", TRUE ~ "normal")) %>%
  mutate(l2fc_bin = case_when(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 5 ~ "≥5",
                              abs(log2FoldChange) >= 4 ~ "4",
                              abs(log2FoldChange) >= 3 ~ "3",
                              abs(log2FoldChange) >= 2 ~ "2",
                              abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "1",
                              TRUE ~ "<1"))

sam_res_plotting$l2fc_bin <- factor(sam_res_plotting$l2fc_bin,
                                    levels = c("<1","1","2","3","4", "≥5"))
```

### 8.1 Summary Volcano Plot

```{r}
volcano_plot <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), colour = reg_label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "#333333") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "#333333") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down-regulated" = "#3B82F6",
                                "Non-significant" = "#333333",
                                "Up-regulated"= "#EF4444")) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
       y = expression(-log[10]("Adjusted p-value")),
       color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/summary_volcano.png",
       plot = volcano_plot, width = 10, height = 6)

volcano_plot
```

### 8.2 Top Genes Labelled Volcano Plot

```{r}
volcano_plot_labelled <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = annotation)) + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "grey80")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(sam_res_plotting, annotation == "GOI"),
                  aes(label = gene_id),
                  colour = "red",
                  size = 3.25,
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
       y = expression(-log[10]("Adjusted p-value")),
       color = "Differential Expression") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/labelled_volcano.png",
       plot = volcano_plot_labelled, width = 10, height = 6)

volcano_plot_labelled
```

### 8.3 Gene Count Bar Plot by Log2FoldChange Bins & Regulation Direction

```{r}
gene_count_plot <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=l2fc_bin)) +
  geom_bar(color="black", aes(fill= reg_label)) +
  geom_text(stat = "count",

            color = "black",
            size = 6,

  labs(x = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
       y = "Number of Genes",

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B82F6", "#EF4444")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/gene_counts_bar.png",
       plot = gene_count_plot, width = 10, height = 10)

gene_count_plot
```

### 8.4 Top & Bottom 10 Genes Log2FoldChange Bar Plots

#### 8.4.1 Top Genes Alone

```{r}
top10_genes <- sam_res_plotting %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
  head(n = 10)

top_order <- top10_genes %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_id) %>% 
  pull()

top10_genes_plot <- top10_genes %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_id, y = log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= log2FoldChange - lfcSE, ymax = log2FoldChange + lfcSE),
                width = 0.4) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(top_order)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Gene ID",
       y = expression(log[2]("Fold Change"))) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/top_genes_bar.png",
       plot = top10_genes_plot, width = 10, height = 10)

top10_genes_plot
```

```{r}
bot10_genes_plot
```

#### 8.4.3 Top & Bottom Genes Together

```{r}
joined_top10 <- bind_rows(top10_genes, bot10_genes) %>%
  mutate(reg_label = if_else(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up-regulated", "Down-regulated")) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange)

joined_order <- joined_top10 %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_id) %>% 
  pull()

joined_top10_genes_plot <- joined_top10 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_id, y = log2FoldChange, fill = reg_label)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2FoldChange-lfcSE, ymax = log2FoldChange+lfcSE), width = 0.4) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = joined_order) +
  coord_flip()+ 
  labs(y = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
       x = "Gene ID",
       fill = "") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-14,14), breaks = seq(-14, 14, 2), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B82F6", "#EF4444")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/joined_top_genes_bar.png",
       plot = joined_top10_genes_plot, width = 10, height = 10)

joined_top10_genes_plot
```

### 8.5 Z-Score Heatmap

```{r}
# Generate Z-Scores
vsd <- vst(sam_dds)
readable_names <- vsd@colData@listData[["readable_name"]]

vsd <- assay(vsd)
Z <- t(scale(t(vsd)))

# Extract row indices of the rows with the highest variation
top_var_genes <- rowVars(vsd) %>% 
  order(decreasing = TRUE) %>% 
  head(20) 

# Subset the Z-score matrix for only the row we're interested in
Z_top_genes <- Z[top_var_genes,] 

# Plot
colours <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(255)

z_score_heatmap <- pheatmap(Z_top_genes,
                            col = colours,
                            angle_col = 45,
                            fontsize_col = 10,
                            fontsize_row = 10,
                            labels_col = readable_names)

ggsave("../visualizations/DESeq2/samples/z_score_heatmap.png",
       plot = z_score_heatmap, width = 12, height = 8)
```
